args.prompt: Reuse EXACTLY the same character as in the reference images (a chibi cat-unicorn: big round white head, two pointy cat ears with pink inner ears, golden spiral horn centered on top, closed happy eyes as upside-down U arcs, pink blush stripes, tiny dark nose and cat 'w' smile, small white bean body, thin stick arms and thin stick legs, bright pink mane behind the head and a big fluffy bright pink tail). Same proportions, same colors, same pixel size in every frame. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size, all frames standing on the same invisible ground line, side view facing right unless stated, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. The character is about 40 percent of the image height. HIT and TIRED animation, 8 frames: (1)-(3) HIT reaction: eyes wide open as round white circles with tiny pupils, small round open mouth 'o', body recoiling backwards, arms thrown up, mane and tail spiky and frazzled, three small yellow stars floating above the head; (4)-(8) TIRED: sitting on the ground on her bottom with legs stretched forward, tongue sticking out, spiral dizzy eyes with stars circling the head in frames 4-5, then frame 6-7 shaking head, frame 8 smiling with closed happy eyes and the right arm waving, mane drooping. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
